existing.funding_period: per year, paid in 12 equal monthly instalments
existing.description: The Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship is a merit-based stipend awarded by Semmelweis University to international students who have an outstanding record after at least two completed semesters. The amount depends on the faculty, with the highest amounts for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry and for the Andras Peto Faculty and the lowest for Health Sciences, and it is paid in 12 equal monthly instalments. Applications for the 2026 intake ran from 1 October to 15 October 2026 through the Neptun Requests interface, evaluation was scheduled to be completed by 30 October 2026, and results could be contested within five business days.
eligibility: Be a foreign national with a valid Semmelweis University student status
Come from a country in the eligible circle listed in Appendix 1 of the call
Be enrolled in a German- or English-taught programme at Semmelweis University

Have begun studies at the Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Dentistry, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Faculty of Health Sciences or the Andras Peto Faculty in or after the first semester of the 2024/2025 academic year
Have at least two active completed semesters with outstanding academic performance
Not be a recipient of Stipendium Hungaricum or the Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship
Have established student status no earlier than September 2024 and no later than September 2027
existing.eligibility_summary: International students at Semmelweis University from the eligible circle of countries listed in Appendix 1 of the call, enrolled in a German- or English-taught programme at one of the participating faculties who began their studies in or after the first semester of 2024/2025, hold a minimum of two completed active semesters with outstanding performance, and are not recipients of Stipendium Hungaricum or the Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship.
benefits: Merit-based stipend with a faculty-specific annual amount
Recognition as a Pannonia In Excellence scholarship holder
coverage: Monthly stipend paid in 12 equal instalments
HUF 2,000,000 per year for students of the Faculty of Medicine or the Faculty of Dentistry
HUF 2,900,000 per year for students of the Andras Peto Faculty
HUF 1,300,000 per year for students of the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences
HUF 900,000 per year for students of the Faculty of Health Sciences
